CustomField.description: Formula checkbox mirroring the parent template's Stages_Mode__c (Form_Template__r.Stages_Mode__c, blanks treated as unchecked). Gives each page a read-only per-record flag so runtime components, Flows, list views, and reports can branch on stage behavior without traversing to the Form Template. Populated automatically; never written directly.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shows whether this page's Form Template runs in Stages Mode, where pages are presented as stages that can be completed in any order from a landing overview. This value is calculated automatically from the parent Form Template and cannot be edited here — to change it, update Stages Mode on the Form Template record.
CustomField.label: Stage Mode
